verdict.rationale: MoonPay's docs describe KYC as a built-in, hosted part of its on-/off-ramp widget and API flow (session creation, quotes, webhooks) and note that returning users can skip re-onboarding, but there is no documented standalone KYC/KYB endpoint or explicit 'counterparty cleared' status API that an ops team could call programmatically before initiating a transfer — KYC is embedded in the transaction flow rather than exposed as an independent compliance-check service. missing for 10: explicit KYC/KYB API/endpoint documentation, a way to query verification/clearance status independent of a transaction, and any B2B/KYB (business) onboarding flow.
